commands.label: Run Metal kernel and read buffer

toolchain: Apple metal 32023.620, metallib, Swift and Metal runtime from Xcode 16.4 on macOS 15.8.2 (arm64)
reproduction_command: xcrun -sdk macosx metal -c hello.metal -o hello.air && xcrun -sdk macosx metallib hello.air -o hello.metallib && xcrun swiftc verify.swift -o verify-metal && ./verify-metal hello.metallib
semantic_scope: The Apple Metal compiler accepted the original shader and metallib linked it. A Swift host dispatched the greeting kernel on a Metal device, waited for completion and printed exactly `Hello, World!` from the 13-byte result buffer. The proof includes the Swift host source.
